title: Peano arithmetic axioms
body:
Peano arithmetic axioms — an engine domain that can touch it: number_theory. Calibration: seals. Five axioms generating the natural numbers: zero is a number, every number has a successor, zero succeeds nothing, distinct numbers have distinct successors, and INDUCTION — if a property holds for zero and passes from n to n+1, it holds for all n. Induction is the engine; the rest is scaffolding.

THE SUBTLETY THAT MATTERS: in second-order form the axioms are categorical, pinning down exactly one structure. In FIRST-order form they are not — there exist non-standard models containing 'numbers' larger than every ordinary one. Arithmetic is harder to say than to do, and Gödel's theorems apply here first: this is the system his incompleteness result is about.

title: Fundamental theorem of arithmetic (unique factorization)
body:
Fundamental theorem of arithmetic (unique factorization) — an engine domain that can touch it: number_theory. Calibration: seals. Every integer greater than 1 is a product of primes in exactly one way, up to order. Existence is easy; UNIQUENESS is the theorem, and it is what makes primes the atoms of arithmetic.

IT IS NOT AUTOMATIC, WHICH IS THE POINT. In the ring Z[√-5], 6 = 2·3 = (1+√-5)(1-√-5) — two genuinely different factorizations into irreducibles. Unique factorization is a property some number systems have and others lack, and recognising that gap is what built modern algebraic number theory. Practically: the difficulty of REVERSING a factorization, not of performing one, is what RSA rests on.

title: Fundamental theorem of algebra
body:
Fundamental theorem of algebra — an engine domain that can touch it: mathematics. Calibration: partial — root counts verify; the existence proof is map-only. Every non-constant polynomial with complex coefficients has at least one complex root; by induction a degree-n polynomial has exactly n roots counted with multiplicity. The complex numbers are ALGEBRAICALLY CLOSED — adding i to solve one equation, x²+1=0, unexpectedly solved every polynomial equation at once.

ITS NAME IS A MILD LIE: every proof is ultimately analytic or topological, resting on continuity or winding numbers rather than on algebra alone. A statement about roots turns out to be a statement about the shape of the plane.

title: Fundamental theorem of calculus
body:
Fundamental theorem of calculus — an engine domain that can touch it: mathematics. Calibration: seals. Differentiation and integration are inverse operations. Part one: the derivative of the accumulated area under f is f itself. Part two: a definite integral can be evaluated by finding any antiderivative and subtracting its values at the endpoints.

WHY IT IS THE HINGE OF ANALYSIS: it converts a limit of infinitely many summed slivers — hard — into an antiderivative evaluated twice — easy. It also joins the LOCAL to the GLOBAL: a rate measured at each instant determines a total accumulated across an interval. That pattern recurs across the floor, in the divergence theorem, in Stokes' theorem, and in conservation laws generally.

title: Euclidean geometry & the parallel postulate
body:
Euclidean geometry & the parallel postulate — an engine domain that can touch it: geometry. Calibration: seals. Five postulates from which Euclid derived the plane geometry of the Elements (c. 300 BC), the model of deductive proof for twenty-three centuries. Four are immediately compelling. The fifth — through a point not on a line there is exactly one parallel — is wordier and less obvious, and generations tried to derive it from the other four.

THEY ALL FAILED, AND THE FAILURE WAS THE DISCOVERY. The fifth postulate is INDEPENDENT: it can be denied without contradiction, which is what produced non-Euclidean geometry and, eventually, the mathematics general relativity needed. Two thousand years of unsuccessful proof attempts were not wasted work; they were the measurement that located an axiom.

title: Non-Euclidean (hyperbolic / elliptic) geometry
body:
Non-Euclidean (hyperbolic / elliptic) geometry — an engine domain that can touch it: geometry. Calibration: partial — curvature relations verify; the choice of axioms is map-only. Deny Euclid's fifth postulate and two consistent geometries appear. HYPERBOLIC (Lobachevsky and Bolyai, 1820s-30s): infinitely many parallels through a point, triangle angles sum to LESS than 180°, negative curvature. ELLIPTIC (Riemann): no parallels at all, angles sum to MORE than 180°, positive curvature — the geometry on a sphere's surface, which is why long-haul flight paths look bent on a flat map.

The angle sum is a measurement, not a convention: it reveals the curvature of the space you are in from inside it, with no outside vantage point required. That is precisely what general relativity needs, and it is why a pure-mathematical rebellion against one axiom became the language of gravity ninety years later.

title: Pythagorean theorem
body:
Pythagorean theorem — an engine domain that can touch it: geometry. Calibration: seals. In a right triangle, a² + b² = c². Known in practice to Babylonian and Egyptian builders long before its Greek proof, and still the fastest way to lay a square corner with nothing but a knotted rope — the 3-4-5 triangle.

IT IS SECRETLY A STATEMENT ABOUT FLATNESS. The theorem is logically EQUIVALENT to the parallel postulate: it holds exactly when the space is flat, and fails measurably on a sphere or a saddle. Generalised, a²+b²=c² becomes the definition of distance in any inner-product space, which is why it reappears as the Euclidean norm in statistics, in least squares, and in the metric of spacetime with one sign flipped.

title: Gödel's incompleteness theorems
body:
Gödel's incompleteness theorems — an engine domain that can touch it: formal_logic. Calibration: map-only — a meta-theorem about systems, not a sealable computation. FIRST (1931): any consistent formal system strong enough to express arithmetic contains true statements it cannot prove. SECOND: no such system can prove its own consistency using only its own rules.

THE METHOD IS THE MARVEL: Gödel encoded statements ABOUT the system as numbers INSIDE the system, then constructed a sentence asserting its own unprovability. Self-reference, made arithmetic.

STATE THE LIMIT OF THE LIMIT, because this theorem is more often misused than used. It does not say truth is relative, that mathematics is broken, or that minds beat machines. It says: no single formal system captures all arithmetic truth, and consistency must be argued from outside. For this project it is the keystone — a tool cannot fully validate itself, so any system claiming to be its own final authority is making a claim mathematics has already refuted.

subject: Gödel's incompleteness theorems

connections.evidence: a theory the sciences and math run on, calibrated

ZFC, being strong enough to encode arithmetic, falls under the incompleteness result — no consistent axiomatization proves its own consistency
incompleteness and undecidability are the same boundary from two sides: the halting problem is the computational face of the unprovable sentence

author: engine

title: Zermelo–Fraenkel set theory (ZFC)
body:
Zermelo–Fraenkel set theory (ZFC) — an engine domain that can touch it: formal_logic. Calibration: map-only — an axiomatic foundation, not a computation. Nine or so axioms about sets from which essentially all of modern mathematics can be built. Devised after the naive theory collapsed: Russell's paradox (1901) asked whether the set of all sets not containing themselves contains itself, and either answer contradicts.

TWO RESULTS DEFINE ITS CHARACTER. The AXIOM OF CHOICE is independent of the rest and yields consequences many find intolerable — Banach–Tarski, in which a ball is cut into finitely many pieces and reassembled into two identical balls. The CONTINUUM HYPOTHESIS is independent too: Gödel (1940) showed it cannot be disproved and Cohen (1963) that it cannot be proved. Some questions are not open pending more work; they are settled as UNDECIDABLE from these axioms, which is a different and stranger kind of answer.

title: Boolean algebra / propositional logic
body:
Boolean algebra / propositional logic — an engine domain that can touch it: formal_logic. Calibration: seals. Two values and three operations — AND, OR, NOT — with laws of their own (De Morgan's, distribution, double negation). Boole published it in 1847 as an attempt to put reasoning into algebra, with no application in view.

IT SAT UNUSED FOR NINETY YEARS. Claude Shannon's 1937 master's thesis observed that a relay is either open or closed, so a switching circuit IS a Boolean expression — and every digital computer since has been built on that identification. It is the clearest case on this floor of pure structure waiting decades for the physical system that would need it, and an argument for keeping mathematics that has no use yet.

title: Kolmogorov probability axioms
body:
Kolmogorov probability axioms — an engine domain that can touch it: probability. Calibration: seals. Three axioms (1933): probabilities are non-negative, the whole sample space has probability 1, and the probability of a disjoint union is the sum of the probabilities. That is the entire foundation.

THE MOVE THAT MADE IT RIGOROUS was recognising that a probability is a MEASURE normalised to total mass one — so all of measure theory applies at once, and questions about infinite sequences and continuous distributions stop being paradoxical. What the axioms deliberately do NOT settle is what a probability MEANS: long-run frequency, or degree of belief. The mathematics is identical either way and the interpretations differ; keeping that separation honest is why frequentist and Bayesian methods can share one calculus.

title: Bayes' theorem
body:
Bayes' theorem — an engine domain that can touch it: probability. Calibration: seals. P(H|E) = P(E|H)·P(H) / P(E). How to update a belief when evidence arrives: posterior ∝ likelihood × prior. A trivial rearrangement of conditional probability, and one of the most consequential.

THE BASE RATE IS WHERE INTUITION FAILS, AND IT FAILS EXPENSIVELY. A test 99% accurate for a disease affecting 1 in 10,000 returns, on a positive result, a roughly 1% chance the person is ill — because false positives from the vast healthy majority swamp the few true ones. Doctors, courts and juries get this wrong routinely; the prosecutor's fallacy is exactly the confusion of P(evidence|innocent) with P(innocent|evidence). This card is on the floor because the same inversion error is the commonest way a true fact produces a false conclusion.

source.label: The Theory Assay — calibrated, not judged (docs/THEORY_CATALOG.md)

subject: Bayes' theorem

connections.evidence: a theory the sciences and math run on, calibrated
Bayes' theorem is derived from the axioms of probability: P(A|B) = P(A∩B)/P(B) is the conditional defined on a Kolmogorov measure space

a p-value is P(data|null) and is routinely read as P(null|data). Bayes gives the correct inversion and shows it requires a PRIOR that NHST never supplies -- which is why a significant result on a rare hypothesis is usually still a false positive. The commonest error in published science is this one missing term

title: Central limit theorem
body:
Central limit theorem — an engine domain that can touch it: statistics. Calibration: partial — sampling checks verify; the asymptotic claim is map-only. Add up many independent random quantities with finite variance and their sum tends to a NORMAL distribution, whatever the shape of the originals. This is why the bell curve appears everywhere: heights, measurement errors, sample means — anything that is a sum of many small independent contributions.

IT IS ALSO THE MOST OVER-APPLIED RESULT IN STATISTICS, and the conditions are the content. Independence and FINITE VARIANCE are required. Heavy-tailed processes — wealth, city sizes, market moves, earthquake energies — violate the variance condition, do not converge to a normal, and are precisely the domains where assuming a bell curve has caused the largest failures. When the tail is fat, the theorem does not apply and the model built on it will underestimate the extreme.

title: Law of large numbers
body:
Law of large numbers — an engine domain that can touch it: statistics. Calibration: partial — convergence checks verify; the limit statement is map-only. As a sample grows, its mean converges to the true mean. The weak law gives convergence in probability, the strong law almost-sure convergence.

WHAT IT DOES NOT SAY IS THE USEFUL PART. It does not promise that deviations get CORRECTED — a run of ten heads is not repaid by extra tails, it is diluted by later trials. That confusion is the gambler's fallacy, and the same error dressed up as sophistication is the belief that a bad streak is 'due' to reverse. Convergence of the average is compatible with the absolute deviation growing without bound.

both say the same thing at different scales: averages over many independent draws converge, so at 10^23 particles a thermodynamic quantity has no observable fluctuation. Irreversibility IS the law of large numbers with Avogadro's number of trials

author: engine

title: Null-hypothesis significance testing (Fisher / Neyman–Pearson)
body:
Null-hypothesis significance testing (Fisher / Neyman–Pearson) — an engine domain that can touch it: statistics. Calibration: seals — a p-value recomputes exactly. Assume the null hypothesis, compute the probability of data at least this extreme, and reject the null if that probability is small.

THE p-VALUE IS P(DATA | NULL). It is NOT the probability that the null is true, and it is not the probability the finding will replicate. Nearly every misuse in the literature is that one inversion — the same error Bayes' theorem exists to prevent.

The threshold of 0.05 is a convention Fisher suggested, not a fact about nature, and the replication crisis is what happens when a convention becomes a gate: p-hacking, optional stopping, and testing many hypotheses while reporting one. This card is on the floor as a warning, not a tool: it is the most widely used and most widely misread procedure in science.

title: Graph theory (Euler, connectivity)
body:
Graph theory (Euler, connectivity) — an engine domain that can touch it: combinatorics. Calibration: seals. Dots and lines — vertices and edges — and everything that follows from which dots are joined. Euler founded it in 1736 by proving that the seven bridges of Königsberg could not all be walked exactly once: such a walk exists only if zero or two vertices have odd degree, and Königsberg had four.

THE MOVE WORTH COPYING is that Euler discarded distances, shapes and the map entirely, keeping only what touches what. Stripping a problem to its connection structure is what makes one theory serve road networks, molecules, epidemics, citations and this corpus alike — a keeping of cards joined by relations IS a graph, and its connectivity, components and degree distribution are measurable facts about the library rather than metaphors.

title: Combinatorial enumeration (permutations, combinations, binomial)
body:
Combinatorial enumeration (permutations, combinations, binomial) — an engine domain that can touch it: combinatorics. Calibration: seals. Counting arrangements without listing them. Permutations when order matters (n!/(n-k)!), combinations when it does not (n choose k), and the binomial coefficients that assemble into Pascal's triangle.

IT IS THE ARITHMETIC UNDERNEATH PROBABILITY: every probability computed by 'favourable over total' is two counting problems in a trench coat. It is also where intuition about scale breaks — 52! ways to shuffle a deck is around 8×10⁶⁷, so a genuinely shuffled deck has, with near-certainty, never existed before in the history of the world. Combinatorial explosion is why exhaustive search fails, which is exactly the pressure that produced computational complexity theory.

title: Linear algebra (vector spaces, eigenvalues)
body:
Linear algebra (vector spaces, eigenvalues) — an engine domain that can touch it: linear_algebra. Calibration: seals. Vectors, the linear maps between them, and matrices as those maps written down. The central objects are EIGENVECTORS — directions a transformation leaves pointing the same way, merely stretched by an eigenvalue.

FINDING THE INVARIANT DIRECTIONS IS THE WHOLE GAME, and it is why this card touches so much of the floor. Eigenvalues decide whether a control loop is stable, which vibration modes a structure has, the energy levels of an atom, the principal components of a dataset, and the ranking in PageRank. A hard problem written in the wrong basis becomes an easy one written in the eigenbasis; much of applied mathematics is the search for the coordinates in which a problem falls apart into independent pieces.

title: Shannon information theory (entropy, channel capacity)
body:
Shannon information theory (entropy, channel capacity) — an engine domain that can touch it: information_theory. Calibration: seals. H = -Σ p log p. Information is measured by how much UNCERTAINTY a message removes, so a predictable message carries little and a surprising one carries much. Shannon (1948) gave two theorems that bound engineering absolutely: source coding, which sets the floor for lossless compression at the entropy, and noisy-channel coding, which sets the capacity above which error-free transmission is impossible and below which it is achievable.

THE FUNCTIONAL IS THE SAME ONE THERMODYNAMICS USES for entropy, and that is not a pun: both count the number of microstates consistent with what is known. The identification runs deep enough that erasing a bit has a minimum thermodynamic cost (Landauer), joining information to physics through a shared equation.

source.label: The Theory Assay — calibrated, not judged (docs/THEORY_CATALOG.md)

subject: Shannon information theory

connections.evidence: a theory the sciences and math run on, calibrated

Shannon's H = -sum p log p and Boltzmann's S = k log W are the same functional, differing by the base of the logarithm and the constant k. Landauer's principle makes the identity physical: erasing one bit dissipates at least kT ln 2 of heat
entropy and channel capacity are defined over probability distributions on a message set

author: engine

title: Church–Turing thesis / computability
body:
Church–Turing thesis / computability — an engine domain that can touch it: computer_science. Calibration: map-only — a thesis, not a theorem. Everything effectively computable is computable by a Turing machine. Church's lambda calculus, Turing's machines and Gödel's recursive functions were defined independently in the 1930s and proved equivalent, which is the evidence: three attempts to capture 'mechanical procedure' landed on the same class.

IT CANNOT BE PROVED, because 'effectively computable' is an informal notion — that is why it is a thesis. What IS proved is the boundary: the HALTING PROBLEM is undecidable. No program can determine, for every program and input, whether it terminates. Some questions are not merely unanswered but unanswerable by any machine, ever — the computational sibling of Gödel's result, arrived at by the same diagonal argument.

subject: Church–Turing thesis / computability

every computation is realizable as a circuit of boolean gates; the thesis is stated over models built from them

title: Newton's three laws of motion
body:
Newton's three laws of motion — an engine domain that can touch it: physics. Calibration: seals. (1) A body keeps its velocity unless a force acts — which contradicts everyday experience only because friction is always acting. (2) F = ma, the working equation of mechanics. (3) Forces come in equal and opposite pairs.

THE THIRD LAW IS THE MOST MISREAD. The pair acts on DIFFERENT BODIES, which is why they never cancel: a rocket does not push against air, it throws mass backward and is pushed forward, which is why it works better in vacuum. The first law is not a special case of the second; it DEFINES the inertial frames in which the second is true.

These hold to extraordinary precision for ordinary speeds and masses, and are superseded by relativity near c and by quantum mechanics at atomic scale — superseded, not refuted: they remain exactly what an engineer should use for a bridge.

source.label: The Theory Assay — calibrated, not judged (docs/THEORY_CATALOG.md)

subject: Newton's three laws of motion

connections.evidence: a theory the sciences and math run on, calibrated

F = ma is a second-order differential equation in position, and it determines nothing without INITIAL CONDITIONS. The law says how things change; the conditions say what is actually happening. Chaos is exactly the case where those conditions can never be known well enough

author: engine

title: Newton's law of universal gravitation
body:
Newton's law of universal gravitation — an engine domain that can touch it: physics. Calibration: seals. F = G·m₁m₂/r². Every mass attracts every other, with a force falling as the SQUARE of the distance.

THE WORD 'UNIVERSAL' WAS THE REVOLUTION. Before 1687 the heavens and the earth were held to obey different rules; Newton showed the falling apple and the orbiting Moon are the same phenomenon at different distances, and derived all three of Kepler's laws from this one expression. That unification — one law for both realms — is the template every later physical theory has copied.

THE INVERSE SQUARE IS GEOMETRY, not a fitted exponent: influence spreading from a point dilutes over a sphere whose area goes as r². Coulomb's law for charge and the intensity of light and sound share the exponent for the same reason.

Newton himself refused to explain HOW gravity acts across empty space — hypotheses non fingo, I frame no hypotheses — and that honesty stood for 228 years until general relativity answered it with curvature.

subject: Newton's law of universal gravitation

connections.evidence: a theory the sciences and math run on, calibrated
the inverse-square force is stated as a force law acting within the three laws' framework

Newton built the calculus in order to state this law and derive its consequences: an orbit is obtained by integrating the inverse-square force, and Kepler's equal-area rule is a statement about the integral of angular momentum. Proposed by the finder; witness: the keeping's own 'Isaac Newton' card, which both retrievals pulled

author: engine

title: Conservation of energy (1st law of thermodynamics)
body:
Conservation of energy (1st law of thermodynamics) — an engine domain that can touch it: thermodynamics. Calibration: seals. Energy is neither created nor destroyed, only converted. ΔU = Q - W: the change in a system's internal energy equals heat added minus work done.

IT IS AN ACCOUNTING IDENTITY AND THAT IS ITS POWER. It forbids the perpetual motion machine of the first kind absolutely, no matter how clever the mechanism, which is why patent offices reject such applications without examining the drawing.

WHY ENERGY IS CONSERVED AT ALL is answered by Noether: it follows from the fact that the laws of physics do not change with TIME. If the rules were different tomorrow, energy would not be conserved. The conservation law is a shadow of a symmetry — and that is a deeper statement than the bookkeeping it licenses.

The first law says the books must balance; it says nothing about direction. That is the second law's job, and the two together are why you can neither win nor break even.

source.label: The Theory Assay — calibrated, not judged (docs/THEORY_CATALOG.md)

subject: Conservation of energy

connections.evidence: a theory the sciences and math run on, calibrated
Noether's theorem: energy conservation is time-translation symmetry as momentum conservation is space-translation symmetry — one principle, two coordinates
energy conservation is time-translation symmetry; the theorem is the reason the conservation laws are not a coincidence but a consequence of the action's symmetries

author: engine

title: Conservation of linear & angular momentum
body:
Conservation of linear & angular momentum — an engine domain that can touch it: physics. Calibration: seals. Total momentum before equals total momentum after, in any closed system. Linear: p = mv. Angular: L = Iω.

IT IS OFTEN MORE USEFUL THAN FORCE, because it needs no knowledge of the messy details in between. Two cars collide, a bullet embeds in a block, a rocket burns fuel — you can relate before and after without ever describing the collision itself. Whole classes of problem are solved by refusing to look at the middle.

ANGULAR MOMENTUM EXPLAINS THE SPINNING SKATER: pulling the arms in reduces the moment of inertia, so the spin rate rises to keep Iω constant. The same conservation keeps a bicycle upright, stabilises a rifled bullet, flattens a collapsing gas cloud into a disc — which is why solar systems and galaxies are discs — and makes a gyroscope resist being turned.

By Noether these follow from the uniformity of SPACE: translation symmetry gives linear momentum, rotational symmetry gives angular. Space has no preferred place and no preferred direction, and momentum conservation is what that fact looks like from inside.

subject: Conservation of linear & angular momentum

connections.evidence: a theory the sciences and math run on, calibrated
the third law makes internal forces cancel pairwise, so an isolated system's total momentum cannot change -- conservation is the third law summed
space-translation symmetry gives linear momentum, rotational symmetry gives angular momentum -- the same theorem, two symmetries

author: engine

title: Special relativity
body:
Special relativity — an engine domain that can touch it: physics. Calibration: partial — Lorentz and E = mc² relations verify; the postulates are map-only. Two postulates (Einstein, 1905): the laws of physics are identical in every inertial frame, and the speed of light in vacuum is the same for every observer regardless of the motion of source or observer. The second is the one that breaks intuition, and everything else follows from taking it literally.

CONSEQUENCES THAT COMPUTE: time dilation and length contraction by the Lorentz factor γ = 1/√(1-v²/c²); the relativity of simultaneity, so 'at the same time' is frame-dependent and not a fact about the world; and E = mc², mass as a form of energy.

THE REAL CONTENT IS AN INVARIANT. Space and time separately are observer-dependent, but the SPACETIME INTERVAL s² = (ct)² - x² - y² - z² is the same for everyone. That is the pattern this theory contributes to the floor: when observers disagree, look for the quantity they must agree on — the disagreement locates the invariant. Minkowski's reading (1908) is that space and time are one four-dimensional structure, which is what makes 'spacetime' a noun.

source.label: The Theory Assay — calibrated, not judged (docs/THEORY_CATALOG.md)

subject: Special relativity

connections.evidence: a theory the sciences and math run on, calibrated
Newtonian mechanics is the v << c limit; at high speed momentum and time dilate measurably (muon lifetimes, particle accelerators)
the constancy of c is Maxwell's own result; special relativity is what remains when that constancy is taken seriously for every observer

author: engine

title: General relativity
body:
General relativity — an engine domain that can touch it: physics. Calibration: partial — specific relations verify; the field equations as a whole are map-only. Gravity is not a force but the CURVATURE OF SPACETIME. Einstein's equivalence principle (1907-1915): being in free fall is locally indistinguishable from floating in deep space, so gravity can be transformed away locally — which no real force permits. Wheeler's summary is exact: matter tells spacetime how to curve, spacetime tells matter how to move.

IT IS TESTED, REPEATEDLY AND AGAINST ALTERNATIVES: the anomalous precession of Mercury's perihelion (43 arcseconds per century, unexplained by Newton and predicted exactly); deflection of starlight by the Sun (Eddington, 1919); gravitational redshift; frame dragging; gravitational waves detected directly by LIGO in 2015; the Event Horizon Telescope image of M87* in 2019. GPS is the everyday case — satellite clocks run fast by about 38 microseconds a day from the two relativistic effects combined, and uncorrected the system would drift kilometres off in a day.

IT ALSO PREDICTS ITS OWN FAILURE. The equations produce singularities — points of infinite curvature at the centre of a black hole and at the start of the expansion — and Penrose and Hawking proved these are generic, not artefacts of symmetry. A theory that outputs infinities is telling you where it stops being the right description.

title: Maxwell's equations / classical electromagnetism
body:
Maxwell's equations / classical electromagnetism — an engine domain that can touch it: electrical. Calibration: partial — circuit and field relations verify; the full field theory is map-only. Four equations (1865) covering all classical electricity and magnetism: charges make electric fields; there are no magnetic monopoles; a changing magnetic field makes an electric one (Faraday); and a current OR a changing electric field makes a magnetic one.

THE LAST TERM WAS MAXWELL'S OWN ADDITION and it changed the world. Adding the displacement current made the set self-consistent — and self-sustaining: a changing electric field makes a magnetic field, whose change makes an electric field, and the pair propagates. Solving for its speed gave 1/√(μ₀ε₀), which matched the measured speed of light. Maxwell concluded light IS an electromagnetic wave — a prediction from pure consistency, confirmed by Hertz in 1887, and the reason radio exists.

A HIDDEN CONSEQUENCE: the equations are not invariant under Galilean relativity. That contradiction between mechanics and electromagnetism is exactly what Einstein resolved in 1905 by keeping Maxwell and changing space and time instead.

title: Quantum mechanics (Schrödinger equation)
body:
Quantum mechanics (Schrödinger equation) — an engine domain that can touch it: physics. Calibration: partial — energy levels and specific relations verify; interpretation is map-only. A system is described by a state vector evolving smoothly and deterministically under the Schrödinger equation; what is NOT deterministic is what you see. The Born rule gives the probability of an outcome as |ψ|², and that step — from a superposition of possibilities to one observed result — has no agreed mechanism. This is the measurement problem, and it is honest to call it unsolved rather than interpreted away.

WHAT IS NOT IN DOUBT is the predictive record: atomic spectra, chemical bonding, semiconductors, lasers and superconductivity all rest on it, and quantum electrodynamics is the most precisely tested theory in science, agreeing with the electron's magnetic moment to about twelve significant figures.

ENTANGLEMENT IS NOT A LOOPHOLE. Bell (1964) turned the question into an experiment: any theory with local hidden variables obeys an inequality that quantum mechanics violates. Aspect, Clauser and Zeilinger closed the loopholes over decades and took the 2022 Nobel for it. The world is not locally deterministic underneath — that is measured, not assumed. No information travels faster than light, because the correlations only become visible when the two records are brought together and compared.

a MIXED STRATEGY and a QUANTUM MIXED STATE are the same object: a probability distribution over pure alternatives, non-negative and summing to one, living on a simplex. Density matrices and mixed strategies share the convex geometry, and both existence theorems are fixed-point arguments over it. Von Neumann proved the minimax theorem in 1928, wrote the Mathematical Foundations of Quantum Mechanics in 1932, and Theory of Games in 1944 -- one mathematics, applied twice

title: Heisenberg uncertainty principle
body:
Heisenberg uncertainty principle — an engine domain that can touch it: physics. Calibration: partial — the bound computes; the ontology is map-only. Δx·Δp ≥ ħ/2. Position and momentum cannot both be sharply defined; narrowing one necessarily widens the other.

IT IS NOT ABOUT CLUMSY MEASUREMENT, and this is the most common error about it. It is not that our instruments disturb the particle — it is that a wave narrow in space is necessarily broad in wavenumber. This is the FOURIER BANDWIDTH THEOREM, true of any conjugate pair whatsoever: the same inequality limits how precisely a radar pulse can give both range and velocity, and how sharply a musical note can have both an onset and a pitch. What quantum mechanics adds is ħ, which sets the scale and makes the limit physical rather than merely mathematical.

Energy and time obey the same relation, which is why short-lived states have broad energies and why unstable particles have a measurable width rather than a single mass.

title: Standard Model / quantum field theory
body:
Standard Model / quantum field theory — an engine domain that can touch it: nuclear_physics. Calibration: map-only — some constants verify; the framework is not a sealable computation. Matter is made of quarks and leptons in three generations, and three of the four forces are carried by exchange particles: photon (electromagnetic), W and Z (weak), gluons (strong). The Higgs field gives mass; its particle was found at CERN in 2012, 48 years after being predicted.

IT IS THE MOST PRECISELY TESTED THEORY EVER BUILT — the electron's magnetic moment agrees with prediction to about twelve significant figures — AND IT IS KNOWN TO BE INCOMPLETE. Gravity is not in it. Neutrino masses are not explained by it. Dark matter and dark energy, roughly 95% of the universe's content, are absent. It has around 19 free parameters that must be measured rather than derived.

HOLDING BOTH FACTS AT ONCE is what this card is for. Extraordinary accuracy within its domain and a known boundary are not in tension; that combination is what a mature physical theory looks like, and pretending otherwise in either direction is the error.

title: Second law of thermodynamics (entropy)
body:
Second law of thermodynamics (entropy) — an engine domain that can touch it: thermodynamics. Calibration: partial — efficiency and entropy changes compute; the arrow of time is map-only. The entropy of an isolated system never decreases. Heat flows hot to cold unaided; the reverse requires work.

IT IS THE ONLY FUNDAMENTAL LAW THAT DISTINGUISHES PAST FROM FUTURE. Every other equation in physics runs equally well backwards; a film of colliding billiard balls played in reverse breaks no law, while a film of a smashed cup reassembling does. That asymmetry is the second law and nothing else — which is why 'the arrow of time' is a thermodynamic question.

AND IT IS STATISTICAL, NOT ABSOLUTE. Boltzmann showed entropy counts microstates: heat spreads because overwhelmingly more arrangements are spread out than concentrated. A cup could reassemble; it is merely one arrangement among a number with more digits than there are atoms in the room.

The practical face is the Carnot limit: no engine converts heat entirely to work, waste heat is a requirement rather than a flaw, and 'you cannot break even' is this law speaking.

The first law cannot answer 'will this reaction go?'; free energy, which is the second law's bookkeeping, can. Proposed by the finder; witness: 'Gibbs free energy -- will a reaction go?'

title: Third law of thermodynamics
body:
Third law of thermodynamics — an engine domain that can touch it: thermodynamics. Calibration: map-only — a limiting statement, not a computation. As temperature approaches absolute zero, the entropy of a perfect crystal approaches zero — and absolute zero itself cannot be reached in finitely many steps.

THE UNREACHABILITY IS THE CONTENT. Every cooling method removes a FRACTION of the remaining heat, so each step gets you closer and none arrives; the effort required diverges as you approach. Laboratories have reached below a billionth of a kelvin and the last step remains infinitely far.

WHY IT MATTERS BEYOND THE COLD: it is what makes the Kelvin scale ABSOLUTE rather than conventional. Zero is not an agreed marker like the freezing point of water; it is the floor of a real quantity. That is why the Carnot efficiency 1 - Tc/Th must be written in kelvin and gives nonsense in Celsius — a ratio requires a true zero. This law is what licenses that arithmetic.

title: Ideal gas law (PV = nRT)
body:
Ideal gas law (PV = nRT) — an engine domain that can touch it: thermodynamics. Calibration: seals. Pressure times volume equals moles times the gas constant times absolute temperature — three earlier empirical laws (Boyle, Charles, Avogadro) collapsed into one.

WHAT 'IDEAL' ASSUMES, because the assumptions are where the card earns its keep: molecules have no volume and do not attract each other. Both are false, and both are nearly harmless at ordinary pressures and well above the boiling point. The law FAILS predictably — at high pressure, where molecular volume is no longer negligible, and near condensation, where attraction dominates. Van der Waals' correction adds one term for each, and knowing WHICH assumption broke tells you which term you need.

This is the model to imitate: a simple relation that computes well, plus an explicit statement of the conditions under which it stops being true. A law that never says where it fails cannot be trusted where it holds.

title: Kinetic theory of gases
body:
Kinetic theory of gases — an engine domain that can touch it: thermodynamics. Calibration: partial — RMS speeds and mean free paths compute; the microscopic picture is a model. A gas is a swarm of molecules in constant random motion, and TEMPERATURE IS THEIR AVERAGE KINETIC ENERGY. Pressure is nothing but the summed impacts of molecules on the walls.

THIS IS WHERE HEAT STOPPED BEING A SUBSTANCE. Before it, heat was caloric, an invisible fluid that flowed between bodies. Kinetic theory replaced the fluid with MOTION — and in doing so derived the ideal gas law from mechanics rather than from experiment, explaining WHY PV = nRT holds instead of merely recording that it does.

The numbers are worth carrying: air molecules at room temperature average roughly 500 m/s, close to the speed of sound, which is no coincidence — sound is a pressure disturbance carried by those same molecules and cannot outrun them. Yet a molecule travels only about 70 nm between collisions, which is why a smell crosses a room by slow diffusion rather than at 500 m/s.

title: Bohr / quantum model of the atom
body:
Bohr / quantum model of the atom — an engine domain that can touch it: atomic. Calibration: seals — energy levels and shell capacities compute. Electrons occupy discrete orbits with QUANTISED energies; light is emitted or absorbed only in the exact amounts separating two levels.

IT SOLVED A CATASTROPHE. Classically an orbiting electron radiates, loses energy and spirals into the nucleus in about 10⁻¹¹ seconds — so classical physics predicts that matter cannot exist. Bohr's quantisation (1913) forbids the intermediate states, and the atom is stable because there is nowhere between levels to fall to.

IT ALSO PREDICTED THE SPECTRUM. The hydrogen emission lines, known empirically as a numerical curiosity (the Balmer series), fell out of the model exactly — which is what turned a bold assumption into physics, and what makes spectroscopy able to identify an element across a galaxy.

The model is WRONG in its picture: electrons are not little planets on tracks, and the full quantum treatment replaces orbits with probability clouds. It is kept because it is right about what is quantised and gives the right numbers — a good ladder to a better theory.

title: Pauli exclusion principle
body:
Pauli exclusion principle — an engine domain that can touch it: atomic. Calibration: seals — electron configurations and shell capacities compute. No two identical fermions may occupy the same quantum state. Two electrons per orbital, and only with opposite spin.

THIS ONE RULE BUILDS THE PERIODIC TABLE. Without it every electron would collapse into the lowest level, every atom would be a featureless blob, and there would be no chemistry — no valence, no bonding, no periodicity, no life. Electrons are forced to stack into successive shells only because the lower ones are FULL, and the shell capacities 2, 8, 18 are the arithmetic of allowed states.

IT IS ALSO WHY MATTER IS SOLID. When you press a hand on a table, what stops it is not electrostatic repulsion so much as degeneracy pressure — electrons refusing to share states. The same pressure holds up a white dwarf star against gravity, and its failure past the Chandrasekhar limit of about 1.4 solar masses is what causes a supernova. One quantum rule, and it explains both the table you lean on and the death of stars.

title: Periodic law (Mendeleev)
body:
Periodic law (Mendeleev) — an engine domain that can touch it: periodic_table. Calibration: seals — element properties and group trends look up and compute. Arrange elements by atomic number and their chemical properties RECUR periodically: reactive alkali metals, then a trend, then noble gases, over and over.

MENDELEEV'S REAL ACHIEVEMENT WAS THE GAPS. In 1869 he left holes where the pattern demanded an element nobody had found, and predicted the properties of three of them in detail. Gallium (1875), scandium (1879) and germanium (1886) were discovered and matched — density, melting point, oxide formula. He also trusted the pattern over the measurements, reordering pairs whose atomic weights contradicted their chemistry, and was later vindicated when atomic NUMBER turned out to be the true ordering.

A CLASSIFICATION THAT PREDICTS IS A THEORY, and that is the standard this card sets for the rest of the floor: an arrangement that only files what is already known is a filing cabinet, while one that says 'there is something here, and it will weigh about this much' is doing science. The underlying cause — electron shell structure, filled under the Pauli principle — arrived sixty years later.

title: Wave optics (Huygens, Snell's law, diffraction)
body:
Wave optics (Huygens, Snell's law, diffraction) — an engine domain that can touch it: optics. Calibration: seals — refraction, lens and diffraction relations compute. Light behaves as a wave: it refracts by Snell's law (n₁sinθ₁ = n₂sinθ₂), diffracts around edges, and interferes with itself.

YOUNG'S DOUBLE SLIT (1801) SETTLED IT for a century: light through two slits produces bands of light and dark, and darkness where two beams meet is only possible for waves cancelling. Then the photoelectric effect showed light also arrives in quanta, and the same double slit run one photon at a time still builds the interference pattern — so the experiment that proved light is a wave became the experiment that proves it is neither, and the card must say so.

DIFFRACTION SETS A HARD LIMIT that no engineering removes: resolution is bounded by roughly λ/D, wavelength over aperture. That is why telescopes are built large, why electron microscopes see smaller things (shorter wavelength), and why a radio dish and an optical mirror obey the same formula — they are the same physics at different points on the spectrum.

title: Acoustic wave theory (harmonics, Doppler)
body:
Acoustic wave theory (harmonics, Doppler) — an engine domain that can touch it: acoustics. Calibration: seals — frequencies, harmonics and Doppler shifts compute. Sound is a PRESSURE wave in a medium, travelling at about 343 m/s in air — and requiring a medium, unlike light.

A VIBRATING STRING OR AIR COLUMN SOUNDS ONE PITCH but is really a sum: a fundamental plus integer multiples, the harmonic series. What makes a violin and a flute at the same pitch sound different is the RELATIVE STRENGTH of those harmonics — timbre is a spectrum. This is the Fourier decomposition of a standing wave, heard rather than plotted.

MUSICAL CONSONANCE IS ARITHMETIC. Simple frequency ratios share many harmonics: the octave is 2:1, the perfect fifth 3:2, the fourth 4:3. Intervals whose ratios are simple sound stable because their overtones coincide rather than beat, which is why the same intervals appear across unrelated musical cultures.

DOPPLER shifts pitch with relative motion — the passing siren — and the identical relation shifts light, which is how astronomers measure a star's velocity from its spectrum.

THE DISANALOGY IS LOAD-BEARING AND IS KEPT: sound is a pressure wave requiring a medium and travels at ~343 m/s in air, while an electromagnetic wave needs none and travels at c. title: Ohm's law & circuit theory (Kirchhoff)
body:
Ohm's law & circuit theory (Kirchhoff) — an engine domain that can touch it: electrical. Calibration: seals — voltages, currents and power all compute directly. V = IR, plus Kirchhoff's two rules: current into a junction equals current out (charge is conserved), and voltages around any loop sum to zero (energy is conserved). Those three statements solve essentially every practical circuit.

P = VI = I²R IS THE ONE TO CARRY INTO THE FIELD. Power lost in a wire goes as the SQUARE of current, which is why the grid transmits at high voltage and low current, why an undersized extension cord gets hot, and why a loose connection — a small resistance carrying full current — is a fire risk rather than merely a fault.

OHM'S LAW IS NOT A LAW OF NATURE but a description of materials that happen to be linear. Metals obey it over a wide range; diodes, filaments, electrolytes and semiconductors do not, and the whole of electronics lives in that non-linearity. Kirchhoff's rules, by contrast, ARE conservation laws and hold unconditionally.

title: Nuclear decay & binding energy
body:
Nuclear decay & binding energy — an engine domain that can touch it: nuclear_physics. Calibration: seals — half-lives, decay chains and mass-energy conversions compute. An unstable nucleus decays with a fixed PROBABILITY per unit time, giving exponential decay and a constant half-life — unaffected by temperature, pressure or chemistry, which is what makes radiometric dating possible and why you cannot hurry or slow it.

BINDING ENERGY IS THE MASTER CURVE. A nucleus weighs LESS than its constituent parts, and the missing mass is the binding energy by E = mc². Plot binding energy per nucleon against mass number and it rises to a peak at IRON-56 and falls away on both sides. Everything follows from that shape: FUSION releases energy below iron, FISSION releases it above, and iron is the ash of both. It is why stars fuse until they make iron and then collapse, why hydrogen bombs and reactors work at opposite ends of one curve, and why no element can be a fuel in both directions.

The individual decay is genuinely random — which nucleus goes next is not determined — while the population is exactly predictable. That combination is quantum mechanics visible at human scale.

title: Elasticity (Hooke's law, stress–strain)
body:
Elasticity (Hooke's law, stress–strain) — an engine domain that can touch it: materials_science. Calibration: seals — stress, strain, deflection and safety factors compute. Within a limit, deformation is PROPORTIONAL to load: F = -kx, or in material terms stress = E × strain, where E is Young's modulus. Hooke published it in 1678 as an anagram — ceiiinosssttuv, for ut tensio sic vis, 'as the extension, so the force' — to claim priority while he kept working.

THE LIMIT IS THE ENGINEERING. Below the ELASTIC LIMIT a material springs back; past the YIELD POINT it deforms permanently; past the ULTIMATE strength it fails. Ductile materials like mild steel warn you by stretching visibly first; brittle ones like cast iron, stone and glass give no warning and fail suddenly. That difference is why building codes favour ductile failure — not because it is stronger, but because it is ANNOUNCED.

Two more facts that kill structures: FATIGUE, where repeated loads far below yield accumulate cracks until sudden fracture, and STRESS CONCENTRATION, where a sharp corner or a notch multiplies local stress several-fold. Most real failures are one of these, not simple overload.

title: Dalton's atomic theory
body:
Dalton's atomic theory — an engine domain that can touch it: chemistry. Calibration: partial — mass ratios verify. Matter is made of indivisible atoms; all atoms of an element share a mass; compounds combine atoms in fixed whole-number ratios (1808).

THE LAW OF MULTIPLE PROPORTIONS was the evidence: carbon and oxygen combine in two ways, and the oxygen masses per fixed carbon are in a 1:2 ratio — which is what you expect if matter comes in indivisible units and is hard to explain otherwise. Chemistry became arithmetic.

Two of the claims are now known false: atoms divide, and isotopes mean atoms of one element differ in mass. The theory is kept because being wrong in its details did not stop it being right in its structure — discrete units combining in whole-number ratios — and that structure is what all of chemistry was built on.

title: Law of conservation of mass (Lavoisier)
body:
Law of conservation of mass (Lavoisier) — an engine domain that can touch it: chemistry. Calibration: seals — balanced equations verify exactly. Mass is neither created nor destroyed in a chemical reaction: the mass of the products equals the mass of the reactants. Lavoisier established it in the 1770s-80s by weighing in SEALED vessels, which is the whole methodological point — combustion appears to destroy mass only if you let the gases escape.

IT KILLED PHLOGISTON. Burning was thought to release a substance; Lavoisier showed metals GAIN mass when they burn, by combining with a component of air he named oxygen. A careful balance overturned a century of theory.

This is why chemical equations must balance, and why an unbalanced equation is not an approximation but an error. Mass is conserved to the precision of any chemical measurement — the mass-to-energy conversion of E = mc² is real but far too small to detect in a beaker.

title: Stoichiometry & the mole concept
body:
Stoichiometry & the mole concept — an engine domain that can touch it: chemistry. Calibration: seals — molar masses, yields and limiting reagents compute exactly. A mole is 6.022×10²³ particles, chosen so that one mole of a substance weighs its atomic or molecular mass in GRAMS. That is the bridge between the scale you can weigh and the scale that reacts.

THE LIMITING REAGENT is the practical heart: a reaction stops when the first ingredient runs out, and everything else is left over. Which one binds is decided by MOLE ratio, not by mass or volume, and getting that backwards is the commonest error in a first chemistry course and in a workshop.

PERCENT YIELD — actual over theoretical — is how real chemistry is judged, and it is never 100%: side reactions, losses in transfer, and incomplete conversion all take their share. This is also Liebig's law of the minimum in another domain: the scarcest necessary input sets the output.

title: VSEPR theory (molecular geometry)
body:
VSEPR theory (molecular geometry) — an engine domain that can touch it: molecular_geometry. Calibration: seals — shapes and bond angles predict directly. Valence Shell Electron Pair Repulsion: electron pairs around an atom push apart as far as possible, and that alone predicts molecular shape. Two pairs give linear (180°), three trigonal planar (120°), four tetrahedral (109.5°).

LONE PAIRS PUSH HARDER than bonding pairs, which is why water is BENT at about 104.5° rather than linear — and that bend is why water is polar, why it dissolves salts, why ice floats, and ultimately why life is possible. One angle carries an extraordinary amount of consequence.

SHAPE DETERMINES POLARITY, and polarity determines nearly all bulk behaviour: boiling point, solubility, surface tension. Carbon dioxide has polar bonds but is LINEAR, so the dipoles cancel and it is non-polar — same bonds, different geometry, entirely different substance. A remarkably crude model that predicts a great deal.

title: Chemical bonding (valence-bond / molecular-orbital)
body:
Chemical bonding (valence-bond / molecular-orbital) — an engine domain that can touch it: chemistry. Calibration: partial — some relations verify; the full theory is map-only. Atoms bond to lower their energy, and three idealised types describe most cases: IONIC (electrons transferred, giving charged ions that attract), COVALENT (electrons shared), METALLIC (a lattice of ions in a shared electron sea, which is why metals conduct and deform rather than shatter).

THE TYPES ARE A SPECTRUM, not categories, and ELECTRONEGATIVITY difference places a bond along it. Equal sharing is purely covalent; a large difference is effectively ionic; most real bonds are polar covalent in between.

TWO MODELS, both useful. Valence bond theory pictures overlapping atomic orbitals and explains shape and hybridisation well. Molecular orbital theory combines orbitals across the whole molecule and explains what valence bond cannot — why O₂ is paramagnetic, why some species are stable with unpaired electrons. Keeping both, and knowing which answers which question, is the honest position.

title: Brønsted–Lowry acid–base theory & pH
body:
Brønsted–Lowry acid–base theory & pH — an engine domain that can touch it: chemistry. Calibration: seals — pH, pKa and buffer calculations compute exactly. An acid DONATES a proton, a base ACCEPTS one. That definition is more general than Arrhenius's (which needed water) and it makes every acid-base reaction a proton transfer with a conjugate pair on each side.

pH = -log[H⁺], AND THE LOG IS THE THING PEOPLE MISS. Each unit is a TENFOLD change: pH 4 is ten times more acidic than pH 5 and a hundred times more than pH 6. Stomach acid near pH 1.5 and blood at 7.4 differ by about a million-fold in hydrogen ion concentration.

BUFFERS are the practical payoff: a weak acid with its conjugate base resists pH change by absorbing added acid or alkali. Blood is buffered by the carbonate system and holds 7.35-7.45; outside that narrow band proteins denature and the body fails. Soil pH decides which nutrients a plant can take up at all — which is why a soil test measures pH before it measures anything else.

title: Hess's law / thermochemistry
body:
Hess's law / thermochemistry — an engine domain that can touch it: chemistry. Calibration: seals — enthalpy sums compute exactly. The total enthalpy change of a reaction is the same whatever route it takes. Enthalpy is a STATE FUNCTION: it depends only on where you start and finish, not on the path.

THE PRACTICAL POWER IS INDIRECT MEASUREMENT. Reactions too slow, too violent or too impure to measure directly can be computed by adding reactions that CAN be measured, because the intermediate steps cancel. You never have to run the reaction you are asking about.

The idea generalises far past chemistry: whenever a quantity depends only on endpoints, any convenient path may be substituted for the real one. Altitude behaves this way and distance walked does not; energy does and heat alone does not. Recognising which quantities are state functions is a large part of thermodynamic reasoning, and Hess's law is the clean case.

title: Chemical kinetics & equilibrium (Arrhenius, Le Chatelier)
body:
Chemical kinetics & equilibrium (Arrhenius, Le Chatelier) — an engine domain that can touch it: chemistry. Calibration: partial — rate constants and equilibrium shifts compute. KINETICS asks how fast, EQUILIBRIUM asks how far, and they are independent: a reaction can be strongly favoured and immeasurably slow. Diamond is thermodynamically unstable relative to graphite at room conditions, and the conversion takes geological time.

ARRHENIUS: rate ∝ e^(-Ea/RT). Because the dependence is exponential, a modest temperature rise produces a large rate rise — roughly a doubling per 10°C for many reactions. That single fact explains refrigeration, cooking times, and why drug shelf life is quoted with a storage temperature.

CATALYSTS lower the activation energy without being consumed and WITHOUT moving the equilibrium — they change how fast the system arrives, never where it arrives.

LE CHATELIER: a system at equilibrium shifts to partly oppose any imposed change in concentration, pressure or temperature. That is the principle Haber-Bosch is engineered against, and the reason its conditions are a deliberate compromise.

title: Phase theory (phase diagrams, Clausius–Clapeyron)
body:
Phase theory (phase diagrams, Clausius–Clapeyron) — an engine domain that can touch it: thermodynamics. Calibration: seals — phase boundaries and pressure-temperature relations compute. A phase diagram maps which state — solid, liquid, gas — is stable at each pressure and temperature. The TRIPLE POINT is where all three coexist; the CRITICAL POINT is where liquid and gas become indistinguishable.

BOILING POINT IS NOT A PROPERTY OF A SUBSTANCE ALONE, it is a property of substance AND pressure. Water boils at 100°C at sea level, near 70°C on a high mountain — which is why food does not cook properly at altitude, and why a pressure cooker works by raising the boiling point rather than by adding heat.

WATER IS THE FAMOUS ANOMALY: its solid is LESS dense than its liquid, so its melting line slopes backwards and ice floats. Nearly every other substance sinks in its own melt. Because ice floats, lakes freeze from the top and life survives beneath — one unusual slope on one diagram with very large consequences.

title: Heliocentrism & Kepler's laws
body:
Heliocentrism & Kepler's laws — an engine domain that can touch it: astronomy. Calibration: seals — a deterministic verifier can CONFIRM or BREAK checkable claims drawn from it. Three laws, from Tycho Brahe's naked-eye positions worked by Kepler between 1609 and 1619: (1) orbits are ELLIPSES with the Sun at one focus, not circles; (2) the radius vector sweeps equal areas in equal times, so a body moves fastest at perihelion; (3) T² ∝ a³, the period squared as the semi-major axis cubed.

THE THIRD LAW IS THE ONE THAT SEALS. Give it a semi-major axis and it returns a period that can be checked against observation to many digits, which is why this card is not map-only. The first law is the one that cost the most: circles had been assumed for two thousand years, and Kepler abandoned them only because Mars' orbit missed a circular fit by eight arcminutes — an error he trusted because he trusted Brahe's instruments. Eight arcminutes overturned the sky.

Kepler DESCRIBED; Newton later EXPLAINED, deriving all three from the inverse-square law. That order matters: an accurate description that cannot say why is still knowledge, and waiting for the explanation would have cost eighty years.

title: Celestial mechanics / ephemeris prediction
body:
Celestial mechanics / ephemeris prediction — an engine domain that can touch it: ephemeris. Calibration: seals — a deterministic verifier can CONFIRM or BREAK checkable claims drawn from it. Computing where a body WILL BE: positions of Sun, Moon and planets, eclipse times, rise and set, tides, and the phase of the Moon on a given night. It is the oldest predictive science and still the sharpest test of one, because the prediction is falsified by anyone who looks up.

THE TWO-BODY PROBLEM CLOSES; THE THREE-BODY PROBLEM DOES NOT. Two masses have an exact solution. Three have no general closed form — Poincaré proved this in the 1890s, and in doing so found the sensitive dependence on initial conditions that became chaos theory. So ephemerides are computed by numerical integration, not solved, and they carry a HORIZON: the solar system is chaotic on roughly five-million-year timescales, and no increase in computing power removes that. Deterministic does not mean predictable.

This is field-useful and not merely academic: planting and harvest by season, navigation by star and by sun, tide tables for a coast, and the date of Easter are all ephemeris problems, and all of them work with no network and no power.

title: Big Bang cosmology & expansion (Hubble's law)
body:
Big Bang cosmology & expansion (Hubble's law) — an engine domain that can touch it: astronomy. Calibration: partial — the Hubble relation verifies; the origin claim is map-only (RESONANCE). v = H₀d: recession velocity proportional to distance, measured by Hubble in 1929 from redshifts and Cepheid distances. That relation computes and checks.

WHAT IS OBSERVED AND WHAT IS INFERRED ARE DIFFERENT CLAIMS, and this card keeps them apart. Observed: redshift rising with distance; the cosmic microwave background at 2.725 K, found by Penzias and Wilson in 1964 while hunting a noise they took for pigeon droppings; and light-element abundances matching Big Bang nucleosynthesis. Inferred: that running the expansion backwards reaches a hot dense beginning. The inference is strong and it is still an extrapolation beyond any observation.

THE HONEST EDGES OF THE MODEL ARE PART OF THE MODEL: ~95% of the mass-energy budget is dark matter and dark energy, both named for what they do not do, and both unidentified. Expansion is space itself stretching, not galaxies flying through space — a distinction that changes what the recession velocity even means. A cosmology that states its unknowns is doing science; one that does not is doing something else.

title: Stellar nucleosynthesis & the HR diagram
body:
Stellar nucleosynthesis & the HR diagram — an engine domain that can touch it: astronomy. Calibration: partial — specific relations verify; the theory as a whole is not a sealable computation. Where the elements come from, and how stars are sorted. Hydrogen and helium (with a trace of lithium) date from the first minutes of the universe; everything heavier was made inside stars. Carbon, nitrogen and oxygen are fusion products; elements up to IRON are built by fusion that still releases energy; past iron, fusion consumes energy, so the heaviest elements require the neutron flux of a supernova or a neutron-star merger.

IRON IS THE HINGE, and it is a binding-energy fact, not an astronomical one: iron-56 sits at the peak of the binding-energy-per-nucleon curve, so it is the ash of every fusion chain. A star that has made an iron core has no fuel left that pays, and it collapses.

THE HR DIAGRAM is the sorting instrument: plot luminosity against temperature and stars fall on a main sequence with giants above and white dwarfs below, and a star's position gives its mass, age and fate. The claim that carries furthest is the plainest one — the calcium in a bone and the iron in blood were assembled inside a star that died.

title: Plate tectonics
body:
Plate tectonics — an engine domain that can touch it: geology. Calibration: map-only — historical and empirical; spreading rates compute. The lithosphere is broken into rigid plates that move over the ductile mantle, at roughly the speed a fingernail grows. They spread apart at ocean ridges, collide to raise mountains, and slide past one another along faults.

WEGENER PROPOSED CONTINENTAL DRIFT IN 1912 AND WAS REJECTED for forty years — not from prejudice but for a good scientific reason: he had no MECHANISM, and his proposed forces were demonstrably too weak. He was right about the fact and wrong about the cause. Acceptance came in the 1960s when seafloor magnetic STRIPES, symmetric about the ridges and recording reversals of Earth's field, showed new crust being created and spreading.

It is the unifying theory of geology: earthquakes, volcanoes, mountain belts, ocean basins and the distribution of fossils all follow from it. The lesson kept on the card is Wegener's — an idea can be correct and properly rejected, and the missing piece is usually the mechanism.

title: Seismology & earthquake magnitude (Richter / moment)
body:
Seismology & earthquake magnitude (Richter / moment) — an engine domain that can touch it: geology. Calibration: seals — magnitude and energy relations compute. Earthquakes radiate P waves (fast, compressional, travel through liquid) and S waves (slower, shear, CANNOT travel through liquid). The gap between their arrivals gives distance; three stations give location.

S WAVES FAILING TO CROSS THE CORE IS HOW WE KNOW IT IS LIQUID. The planet's interior was read from the shadow it casts on its own vibrations — one of the finest pieces of indirect measurement in science.

THE SCALE IS LOGARITHMIC, and this is what public reporting gets wrong. One magnitude unit is TEN times the amplitude and about 32 times the ENERGY. A magnitude 7 releases roughly a thousand times the energy of a magnitude 5, not 40% more. Moment magnitude has replaced Richter for large events because Richter saturates and cannot distinguish the biggest quakes.

Most deaths come from buildings, not from shaking, which is why this belongs beside structural statics: the hazard is geological and the death toll is architectural.

title: Radiometric dating & uniformitarianism
body:
Radiometric dating & uniformitarianism — an engine domain that can touch it: geology. Calibration: partial — the decay arithmetic seals; the assumptions are map-only. A radioactive isotope decays at a rate unaffected by temperature, pressure or chemistry, so the ratio of parent to daughter in a sample gives elapsed time. Carbon-14 (half-life 5,730 y) reaches back tens of thousands of years; uranium-lead (4.5 Gy) reaches back billions.

THE ARITHMETIC IS EXACT AND THE ASSUMPTIONS ARE WHERE THE ARGUMENT LIVES, so the card states them: that the initial daughter quantity is known or zero, that the system stayed CLOSED with nothing added or lost, and that the decay constant has not changed. The first two are testable and sometimes fail — which is why isochron methods, using multiple minerals from one rock, are preferred: they test the assumption instead of making it.

UNIFORMITARIANISM — that present processes are the key to the past — is a working assumption rather than a finding, and the honest framing is that it has been repeatedly tested by independent methods agreeing (varves, ice cores, tree rings, corals) rather than that it is self-evident.

title: Atmospheric thermodynamics (dew point, lapse rate)
body:
Atmospheric thermodynamics (dew point, lapse rate) — an engine domain that can touch it: meteorology. Calibration: seals — dew point, humidity and lapse rates compute. Rising air expands and cools without exchanging heat: about 9.8°C per kilometre while dry, and roughly 5-6°C once condensation begins, because the released latent heat partly offsets the cooling.

DEW POINT IS THE MORE USEFUL NUMBER THAN HUMIDITY. It is the temperature at which air becomes saturated, and unlike relative humidity it does not change as the air warms. Cloud base sits roughly where the rising parcel cools to its dew point — which is why cloud bottoms over a region are all at the same height, a flat ceiling drawn by physics.

PRACTICAL READINGS: when the overnight low is forecast near the dew point, expect fog or dew; a large spread means dry air and a big diurnal swing. Air forced over a mountain drops its moisture on the windward side and descends the lee side warm and dry — the föhn effect, and the reason deserts sit behind ranges.

title: Hydrologic cycle & open-channel flow (Manning, Darcy)
body:
Hydrologic cycle & open-channel flow (Manning, Darcy) — an engine domain that can touch it: hydrology. Calibration: seals — Manning velocity, Darcy flow and catchment volumes compute. Water circulates: evaporation, condensation, precipitation, infiltration, runoff and return. It is a closed budget on a planetary scale, which means every term can be accounted for.

MANNING'S EQUATION gives open-channel velocity from slope, roughness and hydraulic radius — and the practical surprise inside it is that a DEEPER channel flows faster than a shallow one of the same cross-section, because proportionally less water touches the wall. It is why a silted, vegetation-choked ditch backs up and why clearing one is effective.

DARCY'S LAW governs flow through soil and rock: rate is proportional to the pressure gradient times permeability. That is the arithmetic of a well, a drain field, and a contaminant plume.

THE FIELD-USEFUL PART: runoff is what infiltration cannot absorb, so hard surfaces and compacted or bare soil convert rain into flood. Slowing water down — contour, swale, cover, terrace — is the whole of small-scale water management, and it is cheaper than moving it after it has gathered.

title: Physical oceanography (hydrostatics, tides)
body:
Physical oceanography (hydrostatics, tides) — an engine domain that can touch it: oceanography. Calibration: seals — pressure with depth and tidal periods compute. Pressure rises about one atmosphere per 10 metres of depth, which sets every limit on diving, hull design and submersibles.

TIDES ARE A GRADIENT EFFECT, NOT A PULL. The Moon raises TWO bulges, one on the near side and one on the far, because what matters is the DIFFERENCE in gravitational pull across the Earth's diameter — the near water is pulled more than the planet's centre, the far water less. That is why there are roughly two high tides a day rather than one, which is the detail most explanations get wrong. The Sun contributes about half the Moon's effect; aligned, they give spring tides, at right angles, neaps.

THERMOHALINE CIRCULATION is the slow overturning driven by density differences from temperature and salinity — a global conveyor with a turnover measured in centuries, carrying heat that sets the climate of whole coastlines. It is why a port at the latitude of Labrador can be ice-free.

title: Darwinian evolution by natural selection
body:
Darwinian evolution by natural selection — an engine domain that can touch it: biology. Calibration: map-only — historical and empirical; population genetics computes. Three conditions and one consequence: if individuals VARY, if the variation is HERITABLE, and if it affects survival or reproduction, then the population must change over generations. It is close to a logical necessity given the premises, and the premises are observed facts.

IT IS NOT A TAUTOLOGY, despite 'survival of the fittest' sounding like one — a phrase Spencer coined and Darwin adopted reluctantly. Fitness is defined by traits and environment in advance, and the theory makes risky predictions: where fossils should appear in the column, that antibiotic resistance will emerge under use, that a moth population will shift colour with the soot on the trees.

WHAT IT EXPLAINS is apparent design without a designer at the biological level: cumulative selection over many small steps, each individually advantageous. WHAT IT DOES NOT ADDRESS is the origin of life itself, or why there is a universe with laws that permit chemistry — different questions, and a card that pretends otherwise is overreaching in either direction.

title: Cell theory
body:
Cell theory — an engine domain that can touch it: biology. Calibration: map-only — a foundational empirical claim. All living things are made of cells; the cell is the basic unit of structure and function; and all cells arise from pre-existing cells.

THE THIRD CLAUSE IS THE SHARP ONE. Virchow's omnis cellula e cellula (1855) denied spontaneous generation — the belief that maggots arise from meat and microbes from broth — and Pasteur's swan-neck flask settled it experimentally: sterilised broth stays sterile while air can reach it but dust cannot. Life comes from life, and that is a measurement rather than a slogan.

THE CONSEQUENCE IS MEDICAL AND IMMEDIATE: if microbes do not appear from nothing, then sterilisation WORKS, food preservation works, and infection has a source that can be interrupted. Canning, pasteurisation, sterile technique and the whole of food safety rest on this one clause — which is why it belongs on a floor meant for practical use rather than only in a biology syllabus.

title: Mendelian inheritance
body:
Mendelian inheritance — an engine domain that can touch it: genetics. Calibration: seals — ratios and Punnett squares compute exactly. Traits are carried by discrete factors, one inherited from each parent. They SEGREGATE into gametes independently, and a dominant allele masks a recessive one, giving the 3:1 ratio in the second generation of a cross.

PARTICULATE INHERITANCE SOLVED DARWIN'S WORST PROBLEM. Under the blending view then assumed, any new advantageous variation would be halved each generation and diluted away — a serious objection to natural selection that Darwin never answered. Discrete factors do not dilute: they hide and reappear intact. Mendel published in 1866 and was ignored until 1900, so the two halves of modern biology sat unjoined for thirty-four years.

THE HONEST LIMITS: most real traits are polygenic and continuous rather than clean 3:1, genes on the same chromosome are LINKED and do not assort independently, and environment modifies expression. Mendel's peas were chosen — or fortunate — in using traits that are unusually simple.

title: Central dogma of molecular biology (DNA→RNA→protein)
body:
Central dogma of molecular biology (DNA→RNA→protein) — an engine domain that can touch it: genetics. Calibration: partial — codon translation computes; the framework is empirical. Information flows DNA to RNA to protein: transcription then translation. The genetic code reads three bases per amino acid, is REDUNDANT (several codons per amino acid) and is very nearly universal across all life — which is itself strong evidence of common descent.

CRICK'S ACTUAL CLAIM was narrower and more careful than the popular version: once information has passed into protein it cannot get back out into nucleic acid. That specific statement still stands.

THE ARROWS THAT WERE ADDED: reverse transcriptase copies RNA back to DNA (retroviruses, and the basis of HIV drugs and of PCR-adjacent lab technique), and RNA can replicate directly. Neither violates Crick's claim, though both violate the simplified slogan.

REDUNDANCY IS ERROR TOLERANCE. Because several codons map to one amino acid, many single-base mutations are SILENT — the code is arranged so that likely errors tend to be harmless, which is a property an engineer would recognise as designed-in fault tolerance.

title: Hardy–Weinberg equilibrium
body:
Hardy–Weinberg equilibrium — an engine domain that can touch it: genetics. Calibration: seals — allele and genotype frequencies compute exactly. In a large, randomly mating population with no selection, mutation or migration, allele frequencies do NOT change, and genotypes settle at p² + 2pq + q² = 1.

IT IS A NULL MODEL, AND THAT IS ITS ENTIRE VALUE. The conditions are never all met in nature, so the equilibrium is not a description of any real population — it is the baseline of NO EVOLUTION against which real populations are compared. Deviation from it is the measurement: it says something is acting, and how strongly.

This is the same instrument as the null hypothesis in statistics and the same discipline this project applies to its own claims: state what the world would look like if nothing were happening, then measure the departure. It also disposes of a common misunderstanding — dominant alleles do not become more common merely by being dominant. Frequency changes require a force, and 'dominant' is not one.

title: Germ theory of disease
body:
Germ theory of disease — an engine domain that can touch it: medicine. Calibration: map-only — a foundational empirical claim. Specific microorganisms cause specific diseases. Established by Pasteur and Koch in the 1860s-80s against the entrenched MIASMA theory, which held that disease arose from bad air — a theory that was not stupid, since it correctly associated illness with filth and got the mechanism wrong.

KOCH'S POSTULATES made causation testable rather than asserted: the organism must be found in every case, isolated and grown in pure culture, cause the disease when introduced into a healthy host, and be recovered again. That is a standard of proof, and it is why this is a theory rather than an association.

IT IS THE MOST CONSEQUENTIAL IDEA IN MEDICINE because of what it licenses: antisepsis, sterilisation, quarantine that targets contacts rather than air, water treatment, vaccination and antibiotics all follow from it and none makes sense without it. The postulates have known limits — viruses do not grow in pure culture, asymptomatic carriers exist, and some diseases are polymicrobial — so the framework has been extended rather than replaced.

title: Homeostasis & physiological regulation
body:
Homeostasis & physiological regulation — an engine domain that can touch it: medicine. Calibration: partial — specific indices compute; the framework is empirical. A body holds its internal conditions within narrow bounds against a varying outside: temperature near 37°C, blood pH 7.35-7.45, glucose, osmolarity, calcium. Claude Bernard called it the constancy of the internal environment; Cannon named it.

THE MECHANISM IS NEGATIVE FEEDBACK — sense the deviation, act to oppose it — which is precisely a control loop, and the block diagram a physiologist draws for thermoregulation is the one an engineer draws for a governor. Sensor, comparator, set point, effector.

WHAT THIS EXPLAINS ABOUT ILLNESS: many diseases are regulation failing rather than a part breaking. Diabetes is a broken glucose loop, hypertension a reset pressure point, fever a DELIBERATELY raised set point rather than a malfunction. And POSITIVE feedback, which amplifies instead of opposing, is what makes some failures run away — septic shock and cardiac arrest are loops that have inverted their sign.

title: Pharmacokinetics (dosing, clearance, half-life)
body:
Pharmacokinetics (dosing, clearance, half-life) — an engine domain that can touch it: medicine. Calibration: seals — half-lives, steady state and loading doses compute exactly. What the body does to a drug: Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, Excretion. HALF-LIFE is the time for concentration to halve, and it sets the dosing interval.

STEADY STATE TAKES ABOUT FIVE HALF-LIVES, whatever the dose — which means a drug started today may not reach full effect for days, and one stopped today lingers just as long. That single fact explains why antidepressants take weeks to judge, and why a drug can accumulate to toxicity if the interval is shorter than clearance allows. A LOADING DOSE is how you skip the wait when you cannot afford it.

THE THERAPEUTIC WINDOW is the gap between effective and toxic. Drugs with a narrow window — warfarin, lithium, digoxin — need monitoring because the margin for error is small. Since most clearance is hepatic or renal, impaired liver or kidney function means the SAME dose reaches a higher concentration, which is why dosing is adjusted for organ function and for age rather than by body weight alone.
